entities.summary: The Meunier Museum, formerly the Constantin Meunier Museum, is an art museum in Ixelles, a municipality of Brussels, Belgium, dedicated to the work of the realist painter and sculptor Constantin Meunier. It is one of the constituent museums of the Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium.
